name: Promotora Ambiental, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Promotora Ambiental, S.A.B. de C.V. provides environmental services in Mexico. The company offers collection and disposal of waste such as common garbage, organic waste, and recycling; collecting industrial waste, contaminated water, residual chemicals, impregnated containers, and contaminated soil; recycles wood, cardboard, plastic, and metals; management of construction waste; physical, chemical and biological processes for water treatment; sludge treatment; organic waste; and soil improvement services.
